what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Lebanon in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2506 Lebanese asylum seekers in Canada, 28.5% of all asylum seekers from Lebanon.
Refugees from Lebanon, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, Canada, Denmark and France.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Lebanon in these years: with the Islamic State group in 2014, 2015 and 2017.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Lebanon.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 399 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
